title: A socket record.stop suppresses the notice and nobody gets the result
body:
decade sends a `notify` to the asking agent's pane when a recording ends without a `record.stop` (4605830, decade-9418f7), on the reasoning that a stop call returns the result to whoever stopped it. In `decade/src/server/compositor/record.rs` (near line 650) every `record.stop` sets `stopped`, including a socket `record.stop`, which gets no reply of its own (docs/protocol.md). If an agent starts a recording over MCP and a socket client stops it, nobody receives the result: the MCP caller was answered at start, and the notice is suppressed.

## Proposal

Set `stopped`, and so suppress the notice, only when the stop call waits for the result, which is the MCP `record.stop`.
